policy.eligibility: unchanged E012 base eligible19384, additionally strict positive original/corrected intersection; base indices/eligibility remain immutable
policy.correction_order: learned Q*N*A descending, unchanged s0 descending, image/box/key; no detector rescore
policy.source_group_unit: fixed four-site E012 group; apply same cap to each included group during FIT/jackknife/held
policy.originals: immutable prefix, all original scores unchanged; retain E003 as deployed comparator

claim_class: C2 real-road conditional OOF protected detection gain on consumed/reused twelve train sites

fit.model: shared FIT-only unsupervised rank-two PCA plus three ridge role heads; eleven supervised coefficients

A.target: cached admitted AND lost==0 AND FP==0

fit.diagnostic_scope: delete whole positive-support location from ridge training labels/rows only; freeze main FIT8 PCA, context, labels, candidate bank and main gate; label-influence diagnostic, not leave-site-out PCA

content.scope: own FIT base-eligible corrected candidates only; no labels/held in mean,scale,covariance,basis or projection scales
content.weights: GT-free: equal locations, then images within location, then rows within image
content.decomposition: float64 symmetric weighted covariance, np.linalg.eigh once per main FIT; top two eigenvectors, largest-absolute coordinate positive with lower-index tie
content.projection: tanh(standardized_centered_pooled @ basis / sqrt(max(eigenvalue,1e-12))); zero for eigenvalue<=1e-12
content.whitening_and_clip: fixed bounded transform; no rank/feature/eigenvalue threshold search
content.degenerate_components: record variance/gap; zero-rank components yield zero; no rank/arm rescue
